lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A cluster of approximately five large, high-luminance circular nodes arranged in a vertically staggered formation immediately posterior to the gill slits.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Visible vertical bands of elevated intensity intersect with horizontal rows of smaller spots, forming a distinct grid pattern across the mid-lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A primary horizontal ridge with a sharp luminance gradient (bright top, shadowed bottom) extends from the upper posterior region of the head along the dorsal-lateral interface.

other_distinctive_markers: A group of small, greenish biotic objects (teleost fish) is clustered in the water column anterior to the shark's rostrum.
